$comment: The water quality tiers (docs/WATER_RENDERING.md §4; proposals/WATER_GPU_SURFACE.md C1, owner 2026-11-07), cheapest first, in the renderer's order (dwell-client render/water.rs `WaterQuality` indexes this list; the shell's Water setting names them). id: the name the settings store, the presets (shared/settings/graphics-presets.json) and the bench use. label: the Settings button. setting: offered in Settings (false: a device-only tier). cpu: the tier a CPU adapter (software WebGPU) draws whatever is chosen; exactly one tier is the CPU's, and it may not read the scene. readsScene: the water reads a copy of the scene behind it (refraction, depth absorption, shoreline foam, caustics from the caustic tile); without it the water is the fluid's lit body over the sky's reflection, drawn blended. rippleLayers: layers of normal detail (1–3, render/water.rs `LAYERS`). flowStreaks: the foam streaks along the current are drawn (with the Foam streaks setting on). bankBand: the stylized reflection of the bank (`band` below) where the land is not marched (shared/look/reflections.json's ssrSteps 0); needs readsScene. causticEveryFrames: the caustic tile (render/water_tiles.rs) is redrawn every this many frames while the water reads the scene (1: each frame; the first frame with water draws it at once); the caustics drift slowly, so a frame's lag does not show. Run `node shared/look/watertiers.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-look/src/watertiers.gen.rs is stale.

aliases.$comment: Tiers that were removed, read as another (the settings store is append-only: a stored name is kept, and read as its alias). High was folded into Medium in 0.50.29 (owner, 2026-11-07).

band.$comment: The bank band (owner, 2026-11-07, for phones): the land reflected without a march. The reflected ray's point reachM out from the surface is looked up on screen once; where the scene there stands in front of it (the bank above the water's edge, within depthSlack of its view depth), the bank's colour is taken from the scene copy as a soft strip: the mean of taps spreadPx apart across the screen and blurPx up it, darkened by darken, at strength (× the surface's reflectance, as the marched land). Sky and far land beyond it leave the sky's reflection.
